description: WireGuard VPN tunnels for the CardputerZero

store.summary: Connect to your WireGuard VPN tunnels from the keyboard
store.description: WireZero imports WireGuard .conf files into NetworkManager and lets you connect, disconnect and check tunnels from the CardputerZero. Drop a .conf in your home folder, on a USB stick or on the SD card's boot partition, press 5 to import (or 6 to scan your router's WireGuard QR code with the camera), then Enter to connect. Shows tunnel address, DNS and traffic, and can auto-connect a tunnel at boot. Pair it with an SSH app to reach machines on your VPN. Needs NetworkManager (default on the official image). Security-focused: the app never runs as root and private keys stay readable by root only. WireGuard is a registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld; WireZero is not affiliated with the WireGuard project.
